sequence_length.description: 1-D `int32` vector containing sequence lengths, having size `[batch_size]`.

beam_width.description: An int scalar >= 0 (beam search beam width).

top_paths.description: An int scalar >= 0, <= beam_width (controls output size).

output.description: A tuple `(decoded, log_probabilities)` where A list of length top_paths, where `decoded[j]` is a `SparseTensor` containing the decoded outputs: `decoded[j].indices`: Indices matrix `[total_decoded_outputs[j], 2]`; The rows store: `[batch, time]`. `decoded[j].values`: Values vector, size `[total_decoded_outputs[j]]`. The vector stores the decoded classes for beam `j`. `decoded[j].dense_shape`: Shape vector, size `(2)`. The shape values are: `[batch_size, max_decoded_length[j]]`. log_probability: A `float` matrix `[batch_size, top_paths]` containing sequence log-probabilities.
